description: TranSET researchers publish laboratory data for engineered geopolymer composites proposed for road repair and construction. The free Zenodo archive uses CC BY 4.0. The National Transportation Library describes two Excel workbooks from Texas A&M and Louisiana State University within the ZIP. Tests cover metakaolin and metakaolin–fly-ash binders, mortars and fibre-reinforced composites, including strength and pseudo-strain-hardening behaviour. These observations can parameterise material performance in pavement and bridge maintenance simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this project 19CLSU04 package. Coverage is selected laboratory formulations; reported fibre dispersion challenges and low fly-ash reactivity limit generalisation. Ecuadorian local-material feasibility results are a separate context within the project. Internal tables and test uncertainty remain unverified. No workbook was downloaded or durability claim reproduced.
name: Engineered Geopolymer Composites (EGCs) for Sustainable Transportation Infrastructure
